attacks.name: Lightcrusher - Echo Skill 1
attacks.sourceText:
Lunge forward as a Lightcrusher, dealing 84.60% Spectro DMG. Generate 6 Ablucence on hit. Each Ablucence explosion deals 9.40% Spectro DMG.
Hold the Echo Skill to stay in the Lightcrusher form, which allows you to leap up and pounce forward in the air for a short distance.
